subject: penguin
name: 企鹅
label: 迈步的企鹅
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One emperor penguin taking a clear sideways step, natural upright silhouette, lifted flipper and defined neck bib with unfilled areas, no ice landscape.
Pure black contour illustration, smooth empty interiors. Exactly the listed distinguishing details, no extra small decorations, dense texture, feather strokes, hatching, shading or gray fills. Complete connected anatomy and clear all-around margins.
